rationale: The stock is trading near its intraday high (90.6% of range) after a massive gap-down, exhibiting a classic "dead cat bounce" or gap-fill attempt that has already extended significantly from the open. Entering long here offers poor risk-reward due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of fresh volume expansion in the last few minutes (volume declining on the last two candles), while shorting into a strong upward momentum against a positive earnings surprise carries high risk of a squeeze.
